slides.text: Marketing that runs while you're with clients
slides.voiceover_text: Most small firms only market when it's quiet. By then it's already too late. Here's a rhythm that survives a busy month.

slides.text: One channel. Same day every week
slides.voiceover_text: One. Pick one channel where your clients actually are. Post a short useful post the same day every week. Friday morning is a good shout.

slides.text: Keep a running list of post ideas from real questions
slides.voiceover_text: Two. Every time a client asks a question, write it down. Within a month you've got fifty post ideas. The blank page is gone.

slides.text: Use a writing assistant for first drafts. Keep your voice
slides.voiceover_text: Three. Use a writing assistant for the first draft. Then read it aloud and fix anything that doesn't sound like you. Speed of a tool. Voice of a human.

slides.text: One channel. Same day. Real questions. Your voice.
slides.voiceover_text: One channel. Same day every week. Real questions. Your voice on top. That's a marketing rhythm that survives every busy month.
